items.title: The New SEO: From Rankings To Recommendations In AI Search
items.summary: Marketers are redefining SEO amid the rise of AI search, coining terms like AEO, AI SEO, and GEO. The focus shifts from traditional rankings to being recommended in AI-generated responses. Adaptation requires new strategies to thrive in this evolving landscape.

items.title: Google Search Console's New AI Update Is a Goldmine for Easy SEO Wins
items.summary: Google Search Console introduces a new AI-powered update offering quick SEO improvements. It provides insights into SEO, GEO, and AEO strategies for 2026. Marketers can leverage it for high-impact optimizations effortlessly.

items.title: SEO for SaaS just changed overnight: Google's March 2026 Core Update
items.summary: Google's March 2026 Core Update drastically impacts SaaS SEO strategies relying on AI-generated blog content. Sites using 'generate 50 articles with AI and pray for backlinks' are hit hard. Shifts emphasis towards quality and AEO.

items.title: Open-Source geo-seo-claude Tool for AI Search Optimization
items.summary: A groundbreaking open-source tool, geo-seo-claude, optimizes websites for AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude. It performs full GEO audits using parallel subagents, analyzes schema markup, and generates PDF reports. Ideal for boosting visibility in AI-driven search.

items.title: Anthropic's One-Person Marketing Team Powers SEO with Claude AI
items.summary: One non-technical marketer ran Anthropic's growth operations including SEO using Claude Code for nearly a year. Workflow involves CSV analysis, subagents for copy, Figma automation, and live data integration. Achieved 10x output and superior conversion rates.

items.title: SEO 'Dying' Narratives: From Google Ads to GEO/AEO and AI Agents
items.summary: Debunks repeated claims of SEO's death from Google Ads, social search, zero-clicks, updates, AI Overviews, GEO/AEO, to AI agents. Emphasizes SEO's evolution rather than demise. Reality: adaptation is key in changing search landscape.

items.title: Bloomsbury to Publish Two New Sarah J. Maas Books, Sending BookTok into Meltdown
items.summary: Bloomsbury confirmed it will publish two new fantasy titles from bestselling author Sarah J. Maas as part of her A Court of Thorns and Roses series. The announcement has caused a frenzy on BookTok, with fans in meltdown over the major upcoming releases. This news also positively impacted Bloomsbury's share price.

items.title: Emerald Fennell's Wuthering Heights Prompts BookTok Return to Canonical Literature
items.summary: Director Emerald Fennell's film adaptation of Emily Brontë's Wuthering Heights has sparked renewed interest in the classic on BookTok. Users are revisiting the canonical novel, highlighting a trend towards traditional literature amid contemporary romances. This development shows BookTok's influence on reading preferences.

items.title: Hundreds of Australian Writers Secure Landmark AI Copyright Compensation
items.summary: Hundreds of Australian authors are in line for compensation after AI companies used their works to train models without permission. This ruling represents a significant victory in the ongoing controversy over AI's impact on publishing and intellectual property rights. It underscores growing pushback against unauthorized use of creative content.

items.title: NYT Blind Taste Test: 54% of Readers Prefer AI Writing Over Human
items.summary: The New York Times ran an interactive quiz with 86,000 participants comparing AI and human writing, where AI was preferred 54% of the time. This result has fueled debate on AI's viability in journalism and creative writing. Critics argue the test's use of short, decontextualized passages skews perceptions of writing quality.

items.title: NZ Publishing Accused of Leftwing Bias Blocking Traditional Storytelling
items.summary: A commentator describes New Zealand's publishing industry as a 'leftwing circle jerk,' claiming it favors stories with progressive elements like Maori representation, climate change, and anti-capitalism critiques. This makes it difficult for non-woke or traditional narratives to secure deals. The post highlights frustrations with ideological gatekeeping in publishing.

items.title: Thriller Author A.A. Chaudhuri Signs Major 3-Book Deal with JoffeBooks
items.summary: Author A.A. Chaudhuri announced a three-book deal with JoffeBooks, led by editor Kate Lyall-Grant, with the first title The House Swap set for autumn release. She thanked her agent Annette Crossland for the opportunity. This contract reflects strong demand in the thriller genre.

items.title: Rachel Zegler Addresses Backlash to 'Woke' Snow White Reboot Box Office Disaster
items.summary: Rachel Zegler clarified comments on the low box office turnout for Disney's Snow White live-action remake amid widespread audience backlash labeling it 'woke.' The film has underperformed significantly, with criticism focusing on changes to the original story and her political statements. She used Instagram to respond after a clip from an Israeli TV show circulated.

items.title: Disney's Rachel Zegler Refuses to 'Assimilate' Following Snow White Backlash
items.summary: Rachel Zegler stated she refuses to assimilate for others' comfort amid backlash to her casting in Snow White and the film's perceived woke alterations. Her political tweets on the storyline and Middle East issues fueled audience outrage. The remake has been cited as a box office failure.

items.title: Hollywood's 'Woke Bride' Bombs at Box Office, Crushed by Hoppers
items.summary: The film 'Woke Bride' flopped at the box office, earning far less than competitors despite favoring ideology over entertainment. It exemplifies the 'go woke, go broke' trend with audience rejection of preachy content. The story highlights ongoing struggles for Hollywood productions pushing social agendas.

items.title: Hollywood's Woke Mind Virus Leads to Flops Like Snow White $170M Loss
items.summary: Entertainment industry prioritizes social credit and propaganda over profit, resulting in massive losses like Disney's Snow White remake amid audience backlash to woke changes. Predicts collapse as creators focus on ideology rather than entertainment. References Elon Musk's warnings and box office data.

items.title: Hollywood's Latest 'Go Woke, Go Broke' Film Favors Ideology Over Entertainment
items.summary: Post highlights NewsBusters article on 'Woke Bride' bombing at box office, illustrating audience rejection of ideologically driven films. Continues trend of woke entertainment failing commercially.

items.title: Woke Crusades Persist in Hollywood: Actress Faces Backlash Over Anti-Boycott Post
items.summary: Actress celebrates box office success despite boycott by activists, prompting outrage and forced apology from woke crowd. Highlights internal conflicts and exhaustion in preachy entertainment circles. Palestine obsessives reject the apology amid broader cultural debates.

items.title: Mark Cuban Identifies AI Implementation as the Next Big Opportunity for Small Businesses
items.summary: MIT reports that 95% of corporate AI projects fail primarily due to implementation challenges. Mark Cuban compares this to the PC era, predicting massive opportunities in helping 33 million US small businesses, especially one-person operations, integrate AI into their specific workflows. He advises learning AI implementation to walk into businesses like shoe stores or law firms and demonstrate tangible value.

items.title: Google Launches Pomelli: AI Tool Turning Product Photos into Branded Marketing Content for Small Businesses
items.summary: Google's new AI tool, Pomelli, enables small businesses, creators, and marketing teams to transform simple product photos into professional, branded marketing materials. It analyzes brand elements and generates complete campaigns with realistic visuals, eliminating the need for large teams or complex software. The tool is designed for quick, high-quality content creation.

items.title: Intuit Launches AI-Powered ERP Solution Tailored for Small Construction Businesses
items.summary: Intuit has released a new AI-enhanced ERP platform specifically for the construction industry, targeting small businesses to optimize operations. The solution leverages AI to handle complex project management, financials, and compliance challenges unique to construction. It promises significant efficiency gains for SMBs in this sector.

items.title: Launch Commerce Rebrands and Unveils AI-Powered Platform to Streamline Small Business Operations
items.summary: Formerly Launch Cart, Launch Commerce has rebranded and introduced an AI-driven platform that unifies tools for small businesses to automate lead follow-ups and improve response times. It addresses the pain of juggling multiple apps, helping capture missed opportunities efficiently. The platform aims to provide a single AI system for better sales and customer engagement.
